headline: Offline-first logging with background sync
detail: Full local write path with conflict resolution; logs queue for up to 30 days without connectivity.

headline: Health Connect and HealthKit two-way sync GA
detail: Workouts, weight and nutrition flow both directions; positions the app as the hub rather than the source.

headline: SOC 2 Type II, SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning for all plans
detail: Removes the enterprise security objection at the low end of the market; publishes a VPAT.

headline: Cohort participation reporting with de-identified CSV export
detail: Monthly automated reports for benefits teams; minimum cohort size configurable for anonymity.

headline: Streaks, weekly badges and smart reminder windows
detail: Reminder timing learned from historical logging times rather than fixed schedules.

headline: Full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance, published ACR
detail: Screen-reader support for all primary charts; adds high-contrast dark theme.

headline: Price increase to $12.99/mo, annual $79.99, 14-day trial
detail: Removed the free-tier logging cap in the same change — free tier now unlimited manual logging.

headline: Weight trend with moving average and forecast band
detail: Ships the single most requested Kiro Fit premium analytic as a free-tier feature.

headline: Department challenges with privacy-preserving leaderboards
detail: Aggregate-only rankings designed to satisfy HR objections to individual leaderboards.

headline: AI-generated training plans with weekly adaptation
detail: Plan generated from profile, goal and logged history; regenerates weekly against actual adherence. Marketed as the headline paid feature.

headline: Monthly progress report with plain-language summary
detail: Weekly and monthly PDF/web report; a short generated narrative explains the trend and names one thing to change.

headline: Per-user unit system across all surfaces
detail: Unit preference moved out of regional defaults into an explicit per-user setting covering mass, height and distance.

headline: Programme-level plan seeding with per-participant adaptation
detail: Programme admins publish a starting plan; each participant's copy adapts on logged adherence. Positioned for employer contracts.

headline: Engineering note: plan generation on a managed foundation model
detail: Reports $0.018 per active user per month for plan generation and report narration on a managed model, with a cached static plan as the outage fallback.
